# Test fixtures

`gdpr_sample.html` is an unmodified excerpt of the official English GDPR text
(Regulation (EU) 2016/679, CELEX `32016R0679`). It was cut from the CELLAR XHTML rendition
(`http://publications.europa.eu/resource/celex/32016R0679`) and keeps the original markup for:

- recitals 1 and 3 (recital 3 contains a footnote call)
- Chapter I with Articles 1 and 4 (Article 4 has no numbered paragraphs)
- Chapter II with Article 6 (numbered paragraphs and list points)

All other elements were removed. EU legislation may be reused under Commission Decision
2011/833/EU; the source is © European Union, https://eur-lex.europa.eu.
